<details>
- The `source` entry is a straightforward GitHub tarball URL. Running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` will download and extract this archive using standard tools like `curl` or `wget`, which is expected behavior and does not execute any code.

- Consequently, both `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` only perform normal source retrieval and parsing without invoking any untrusted or harmful actions.
</details>
